speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a concerning rash and recent health changes; to help me understand what is happening, can you tell me how long you have had these symptoms and if you have noticed any fever or weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug eruption secondary to new arthritis medication (likely NSAID or DMARD). The sudden onset of a widespread rash accompanied by a new cough shortly after starting a new primary care regimen for arthritis is highly suggestive of a hypersensitivity reaction. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Liver_Function_Tests.
